blurb: Guests board a 70-foot catamaran at Heeia Kea Boat Harbor and cruise to the Kaneohe Sandbar in Kaneohe Bay. Activities include snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, banana boat rides, bumper tubes, and relaxing on the sandbar. Tours feature live Hawaiian music and provide a light lunch on the standard tour and additional activities on the all-inclusive tour.
